close-confirm-window.description: Permissions for the close-confirm dialog window. It is an embedded shell page served by the close-dialog custom protocol (not the Claw service origin), so no remote access declaration is needed.

main-window.description: Permissions for the main Claw window. The main window loads the Claw service from http://127.0.0.1:<port> (an external URL, i.e. a remote origin for the Tauri IPC ACL), so remote access must be declared for IPC-based features such as notifications to work.
